characters.name: O Sussurro
characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create a production character art sheet for Post Mortem Arena. Reference image is ONLY the exact character identity: keep adult brown-skinned man, narrow gray eyes, swept-back long black hair with ONE braid over shoulder, sparse mustache and pointed goatee, jade beads and small gold tubes in braid/necklace, black high-collar uniform with large asymmetric ivory lapel and subtle gold piping. Convert the slightly painterly reference to STRICT hand-drawn 2D TV ANIME: crisp ink contours, flat clean colors, hard graphic cel shadows, no realism, no 3D, no oil texture.
Canvas 1536x1024, exact seamless 3 columns by 2 rows, SIX equal square illustrations, NO panel borders, gutters, text, letters, captions, watermark. Each cell is independently crop-safe with centered readable main action.
World: Inferno, Elo Mentira, a sinister realm of whispers and deception, jade green spiritual poison, black lacquer, false reflections, old imperial eastern architecture. No modern technology, no flames, no tentacles, no literal written words, no floating eyeballs. Character is a manipulative charismatic whispering saboteur, not generic wizard. Clothes and accessories EXACTLY consistent all six scenes. Anatomically coherent attached limbs, two arms, five fingers if visible; prefer closed hands, no gore.
Order:
1 TOP LEFT PORTRAIT: waist-up three-quarter view at a rain-soaked covered merchant arcade, our man looks back over one shoulder with a calculating half smile, ONE braid, jade ear ornament, ivory lapel clearly visible. Diagonal poles and far jade lantern light. Not same setting/camera as reference.
2 TOP MIDDLE PASSIVE Segredo em Circulação: extreme close profile of his recognizable face in foreground on left, one already poisoned armored enemy in middle distance right clutching their chest with a thin jade vein-shaped glow at neck; setting dusty archive storeroom with sealed scroll cases. Our man calmly notices poison vulnerability, no attack beam, exactly TWO figures.
3 TOP RIGHT Palavra Envenenada: overhead diagonal medium wide in a moonlit stone canal crossing, man leans toward ONE enemy, a thin curling jade whisper emerges clearly from his mouth and reaches enemy's ear then coils down to their chest. A small poisoned spark on enemy's sheathed weapon suggests it will backfire on offense. Both standing on solid stone walkway. One caster, one foe, not a crowd.
4 BOTTOM LEFT Segredo Cobrado: low SIDE action in a desolate courtyard with one red dry maple, man delivers ONE closed-fist physical strike to ONE poisoned opponent's armored ribs, no penetrating hand/body. ONE small jade essence mote travels FROM opponent's waist TO caster's chest. Face and distinctive braid/lapel visible. Clear physical hit plus resource theft; just two figures.
5 BOTTOM MIDDLE Aviso Falso: medium wide in an indoor abandoned opera rehearsal room. Exactly THREE people total: our caster at LEFT gives a subtle warning gesture, ONE allied adult woman in plain slate traveling clothes CENTER ducks below a sword slash and counter-strikes the SAME armored attacker at RIGHT with her short staff. Thin jade afterimage outline left at her previous head position communicates enemy strike annulled. One caster, one ally, one enemy. No shield around group, no fourth face in mirrors, no attack hitting ally.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT Voz sem Origem PERSONAL DEFENSE: close oblique low angle inside a quiet tiled bathhouse corridor, our man ALONE slips sideways into a thin vertical jade sound-ripple silhouette, ONE incoming arrow passes through his fading former shoulder position and hits empty wall. Solid current face visible, one braid, coat and ivory lapel. Ghostlike outline is clearly an empty echo, no duplicate solid head/body, no protected ally. Self-only invulnerability, no dome or group shield.
Vary shot scale, camera and background radically between all six cells, retain dark anime drama and readable silhouettes at icon size.
review: Crisp anime linework and cel shadows; original face, braid, jade beads and ivory lapel preserved.
Six separate settings and cameras; attacks target one enemy, counter protects one ally, defense only the caster.
Six square crops 512x512; original game references preserved.
